Valuation remains undemanding but the investment case now rests on execution rather than multiple expansion.

headline: Cooper Investors defends Amcor against sustainability concerns, arguing plastic packaging recyclability narrative is overstated and management is investing seriously in solutions
reasoning: Amcor has been maligned by investors due to its exposure to plastic waste and the perceived greater sustainability of alternative packaging materials such as aluminium and glass. Cooper Investors argues the evidence does not yet support this view on a long-term basis, noting that alternative substrates have a higher end-to-end emissions footprint that is not fully accounted for. Management is investing in innovation to make their portfolio 100% recyclable by 2025, with 61% of flexible packaging and 95% of rigids currently recyclable on existing infrastructure. AMC is also a core partner of the New Plastics Economy initiative involving recyclers, brand owners, packaging companies and policymakers. Cooper Investors believes AMC has the scale, resources and management intentionality to contribute meaningfully to addressing plastic waste issues.
quote: AMC has been much maligned by investors as having a limited future due to its exposure to plastic waste, and in particular the greater sustainability of other packaging materials (aluminium, glass). In our view the evidence is not yet there to make this observation on a long term basis. Although we recognise greater levels of recycling today in these other packaging substrates, there is little account taken of their emissions footprint (which on an end to end basis appears to be higher than that of plastic) nor of the strides being taken by the plastic manufacturers and users towards recyclability. We believe AMC management take their contribution to the issue of plastic waste very seriously and continue to invest in innovation that will endeavour to make their product portfolio 100% recyclable by 2025.
episode_title: CI Australian Equities Fund Quarterly Report 30 September 2020
